title: Overview
description: Is everything fine? One tile per alerting row (red needs attention, a click opens its dashboard), the alerts firing and four charts of the last 24 h (docs/monitoring.md, "Dashboards").

list.name: Deployments
list.expr: count by (version) (findaline_build_info) unless count by (version) (findaline_build_info offset 5m)

panels.title: Site (C6)
panels.description: Status of the home page through the site's public address, asked from the server. Alert when not 200 for 2 min.

panels.title: Ping (G1)
panels.description: The timer that pings healthchecks.io while the site answers; a missing ping is reported by healthchecks.io itself, not here.

panels.title: 5xx (C1)
panels.description: Share of the answers with a 5xx status. Alert above 2 % for 5 min (at least 20 requests).

panels.title: API p95 (C2)
panels.description: 95th percentile of nginx's request time of /api/ (event streams not included). Alert above 2 s for 10 min.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: All groups, mean of 5 min.

panels.title: Limits (C3)
panels.description: Requests refused by nginx's limit_req zones.

panels.title: Cert (C5)
panels.description: Days until the site's certificate expires; certbot renews from 30. Alert below 14.

panels.title: Bans (D2)
panels.description: Alerts: more than 10 bans of the site's jail or 100 of sshd in an hour.

panels.title: The server (A, B, D, E, G2)
Steal (A1)
panels.description: Time the hypervisor gave to the provider's other customers, mean of 5 min. Alert above 20 % for 15 min.

panels.title: RAM (A2)
panels.description: Alert below 5 % for 5 min.

panels.title: OOM (A2)
panels.description: Processes the kernel killed for lack of memory (host-wide, also inside containers). Alert on any.

panels.title: Docker (A3)
panels.description: Docker's data root: the site's data, runs and cache, and this monitoring. The site refuses searches below 20 GB; alert below 30 GB.

panels.title: Full in (A3)
panels.description: Days until the disk is full at the rate of the last 7 days (linear).

panels.title: Root / (A3)
panels.description: Alert below 10 GB.

panels.title: Holes (A4)
panels.description: Unallocated parts of the disk image of --disk-image (host facts); vps.sh check fails above 1 GiB.

panels.title: Clock (A8)
panels.description: chronyd's offset from NTP time. Alert above 1 s.

panels.title: web, worker
panels.description: web: its healthcheck; worker: running (it has no healthcheck). Alerts: not running, web unhealthy for 2 min.

panels.title: W RAM (B2)
panels.description: Of WORKER_MEMORY (without the page cache). Alert above 90 % for 5 min.

panels.title: Units (D1)
panels.description: Units failed or not loaded (nginx, docker, fail2ban, ssh, unattended-upgrades and the timers).

panels.title: Check (D3)
panels.description: The daily check of the firewall, headers, SSH and the jail. Alert on any FAIL.

panels.title: Backup (E1)
panels.description: Age of the last successful backup. Alert above 26 h.

panels.title: Apt (A7)
panels.description: Packages with an update; unattended-upgrades installs the security ones every day.

panels.title: Worker (F1)
panels.description: Workers with a live lease (renewed every 5 s, valid 30 s). Alert: none for 2 min.

panels.title: Queue (F2)
panels.description: Searches waiting or running against queue_max (new searches are refused at 100 %). Alert above 80 %.

panels.title: Waiting (F2)
panels.description: Age of the oldest queued or downloaded search not yet running. Alert above 30 min.

panels.title: Running (F2)
panels.description: Searches in each phase now (the worker's slots: the chart below).

panels.title: Internal (F3)
panels.description: In the last 24 hours: searches failed by an unexpected exception ("internal error, ref ..." for the user). Alert on any.

targets.expr: (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{error="internal"}) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{error="internal"} offset 24h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 24h) * 0)

panels.title: Failed (F3)
panels.description: Share of the searches finished in the last hour that failed. Alert above 30 % (at least 3 finished).

targets.expr: ((sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{status="failed"}) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{status="failed"} offset 1h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 1h) * 0)) / ((sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total offset 1h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 1h) * 0)) * 100

panels.title: Quick (F5)
panels.description: Age of the oldest waiting estimate, profile or place lookup. Alert above 30 s.

panels.title: Clean (F13)
panels.description: Time since the worker's housekeeping last ended (every 6 h); the alert fires after 18 h.

panels.title: Pending (F6)
panels.description: Accounts waiting for approval on the Admin page. Info: a new one.

panels.title: Reports (F8)
panels.description: Problem reports not marked done (Admin page). Info: a new one.

panels.title: Refused (F7)
panels.description: Requests refused by a rate or a quota in the last hour (audit). Alert: more than 20 and 3 times the hourly mean of the day before.

panels.title: Active (F7)
panels.description: Signed-in sessions seen within the window (15 min, 24 h).

panels.title: km² today
panels.description: km² of the searches finished in the last 24 hours (computed; in total: the panel to the right) and km² of new terrain data downloaded for them (the rest came from the cache).

targets.expr: (sum(findaline_area_km2_total) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_area_km2_total offset 24h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 24h) * 0)
(sum(findaline_download_km2_total{role="terrain"}) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_download_km2_total{role="terrain"} offset 24h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 24h) * 0)

panels.title: Hosts (F11)
panels.description: Outside services with more than 20 % of their requests failed in the last 30 min (at least 10 requests), as the alert F11.

targets.expr: count((((sum by (host) (findaline_service_requests_total{outcome!~"ok|not_found"}) or sum by (host) (findaline_service_requests_total) * 0) - (sum by (host) (findaline_service_requests_total{outcome!~"ok|not_found"} offset 30m) or sum by (host) (findaline_service_requests_total) * 0 and on () max(findaline_build_info offset 30m))) / (sum by (host) (findaline_service_requests_total) - (sum by (host) (findaline_service_requests_total offset 30m) or sum by (host) (findaline_service_requests_total) * 0 and on () max(findaline_build_info offset 30m))) * 100 and (sum by (host) (findaline_service_requests_total) - (sum by (host) (findaline_service_requests_total offset 30m) or sum by (host) (findaline_service_requests_total) * 0 and on () max(findaline_build_info offset 30m))) >= 10) > 20) or vector(0)

panels.title: Mpx today
panels.description: Mpx (km² / resolution²) of the searches finished in the last 24 h: the measure of the compute quota.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The application's version (pyproject.toml). A new version is marked on the charts.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: The alert rules of the folder Find-a-Line now firing or pending (both levels, alert and info).

panels.title: Searches by status (F2)
panels.description: Waiting (queued, ready: downloaded) and running (downloading, computing); new searches are refused at queue_max.

panels.title: CPU and memory used (A1, A2)
panels.description: CPU busy (all but idle, all cores) and memory used (all but available), in % of the server's.

panels.title: Error lines per 5 minutes
panels.description: Lines of level error by source (the application: exceptions, tracebacks, internal errors; nginx: error, crit, alert, emerg).
